# Worker environment bundle controls

These JavaScript two-argument owner bodies preserve numeric/string writers,
keystream setup and a worker-side environment emitter. Representative files are
[two-argument-owner-baseline.js](two-argument-owner-baseline.js),
[two-argument-owner-guarded-layout.js](two-argument-owner-guarded-layout.js) and
[helper-count-owner.js](helper-count-owner.js). Branch, numeric, mixed, reset,
held-out and alternate layouts provide independent lowering controls.

[The integration target](../../naming_worker_environment_bundle.rs) wraps each
saved owner in its carrier and checks both container and emitter roles through
production naming. The emitter serializes environment fields and a prototype
property count with a seeded header, then posts the payload and byte pair.
The container's helpers and its call to the emitter must each be proved.

Accepted forms include the shared numeric-writer fallback. A changed numeric
sign tag remains a refusal; broader recognition must preserve the canonical role,
evaluator and explanation metadata rather than borrowing another helper's role.

Preserve source bytes, field/write order, null handling, seed derivation and the
unbound postMessage sink. These are static captured inputs, not development
scripts to execute in a worker. Read next:
[float writer controls](../software_float_byte_writer/README.md) and
[the fixture collection](../).
